令

$$
F(x,y,z)=x^2+y^2+z^2-4z
$$

则 $F_x=2x,F_z=2z-4$，

$$
\therefore\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_x}{F_z}=\frac{x}{2-z},\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2}=\frac{(2-z)+x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}}{(2-z)^2}=\frac{(2-z)+x\cdot\frac{x}{2-z}}{(2-z)^2}=\frac{(2-z)^2+x^2}{(2-z)^3}
$$
